name: Edge browser and machine BIC proposal

rules.description: Baseline BIC already on; no additional protection
rules.expression: (not (http.host in {"finance.tuturuuu.com" "finance-staging.tuturuuu.com"}) and http.host in {"colab.tuturuuu.com" "hive.tuturuuu.com" "lettin.tuturuuu.com" "meet.tuturuuu.com" "parley.tuturuuu.com"} and not (not (http.host in {"finance.tuturuuu.com" "finance-staging.tuturuuu.com"}) and ((http.host in {"colab.tuturuuu.com" "hive.tuturuuu.com" "lettin.tuturuuu.com" "meet.tuturuuu.com" "parley.tuturuuu.com"} and (http.request.uri.path in {"/api" "/verify-token" "/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml" "/manifest.webmanifest" "/site.webmanifest" "/sw.js"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/static/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/"))) or (http.host eq "meet-realtime.tuturuuu.com" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/health" "/realtime" "/room-state" "/room-device" "/room-service" "/channels" "/channels/publish" "/channels/document" "/collaboration" "/collaboration/seed" "/collaboration/checkpoint" "/collaboration/runner-files"})) or (http.host eq "colab.tuturuuu.com" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/auth/login" "/auth/callback"})) or (http.host eq "hive.tuturuuu.com" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/realtime"})))))

rules.description: Machine transport opts out of BIC and Under Attack checks
rules.expression: (not (http.host in {"finance.tuturuuu.com" "finance-staging.tuturuuu.com"}) and ((http.host in {"colab.tuturuuu.com" "hive.tuturuuu.com" "lettin.tuturuuu.com" "meet.tuturuuu.com" "parley.tuturuuu.com"} and (http.request.uri.path in {"/api" "/verify-token" "/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml" "/manifest.webmanifest" "/site.webmanifest" "/sw.js"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/static/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/"))) or (http.host eq "meet-realtime.tuturuuu.com" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/health" "/realtime" "/room-state" "/room-device" "/room-service" "/channels" "/channels/publish" "/channels/document" "/collaboration" "/collaboration/seed" "/collaboration/checkpoint" "/collaboration/runner-files"})) or (http.host eq "colab.tuturuuu.com" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/auth/login" "/auth/callback"})) or (http.host eq "hive.tuturuuu.com" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/realtime"}))))
